content: If I have seen further it is by standing on the shoulders of Giants.
author: Isaac Newton
story:
Preserved as part of Isaac Newton's enduring intellectual legacy, this reflection addresses the fundamental nature of humility and science. Across his life and work, Isaac Newton returned repeatedly to the conviction that personal integrity, honest observation, and clarity of purpose are the foundational pillars of a life well-lived.

Contemplating this truth invites us to step back from the frantic rush of daily demands. By examining our assumptions with fresh eyes, we discover the inner grounding necessary to act with wisdom and quiet conviction.
reflectionPrompt: How can you integrate the essence of this wisdom into one specific decision or encounter today?
